title: Final Answer for (a)
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly state that the water in the bottle will not boil due to thermal equilibrium with the boiling water.

title: Final Answer for (b)
description: Essential Criteria: The student must explain that boiling ceases due to increased pressure raising the boiling temperature.

title: Final Answer for (c)
description: Essential Criteria: The student must recommend pouring cold water and explain its effect on pressure and boiling.

title: Reasoning for (a)
description: Important Criteria: The student should provide reasoning related to heat transfer and latent heat of vaporization.

title: Pressure Explanation for (b)
description: Important Criteria: The student should reference the phase diagram and the relationship between pressure and boiling temperature.

title: Understanding of Phase Changes
description: Optional Criteria: The student may discuss the concept of phase changes and how pressure affects boiling.

title: Common Errors in (a)
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must avoid stating that the water will boil without explaining the thermal equilibrium.

title: Common Errors in (b)
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should not overlook the importance of pressure changes in the boiling process.
